finalText:
Dedup is in, at `src/router.js:29`.

`createState()` now carries `lastSentAt` (key → `at` of the last delivery for that key). A notification whose key was delivered less than 5 minutes ago returns `[]`; only actual deliveries stamp the map, so a dropped repeat doesn't extend the window and a queued notification does count as sent.

Replay: 99 drops, 0 errors — exactly the flaps `events.js` plants (same key, +2 minutes). Sample pair: `evt-0287 @1 → queue`, then `evt-0288 @3 → (dropped)`. Deliveries fell accordingly (pager 225→200, queue 300→266).

Dedup runs ahead of the quiet-hours rule, so a repeat is suppressed rather than queued. I used a strict 5-minute window — a repeat exactly 5 minutes later goes through; say the word if you want that boundary inclusive.
